_header: The review classes (lane autopilot-reviews, O-REVIEWS-DEPEND-ON-THE-LAPTOP). Owner rule 2026-09-29: an auth, money, user-data or API pull request gets an INDEPENDENT review before it may merge. .github/workflows/review-gate.yml runs tooling/autopilot/review-paths.mjs over a PR's file list and adds `needs-review` when any path matches a glob below; tooling/ci/land-next.mjs then waits for an owner's `VERDICT: APPROVE` on the head. Name globs are scoped to the product roots (apps, packages, services, sites, extensions) so a tooling test named after a class is not a review. Globs: `**` any depth, `*` within one segment, `{a,b}` alternatives; matched case-insensitively against the repo-relative path. Seeded from the brief, refined from this tree (packages/, services/*/src/routes, services/*/migrations, contracts/). ⏱ 2026-10-02 (review of #1171, finding 3): ALL Worker source is api (services/*/src/**, queries/**, migrations/**), the store-receipt verifiers and packages/core money are money, token-crypto and provider-revoke are auth, the D1 backup and the mail adapters are user-data; a red control classifies one REAL tracked file from each. ⏱ 2026-10-03 (round 2 of #1171, finding 1): the Worker configs `services/*/wrangler.*` (the auth issuer, the native-attestation policy, CORS, the limiters) are api AND auth; `tooling/edge-ratelimit-rule.json` and its applier `tooling/ops/edge-ratelimit-rule.mjs` are auth; the app brick's backend template `tooling/bricks/app/__brick__/**/*-api/**` is api and its `*-api/src/middleware/**` is auth. A sweep in the test classes every tracked file under services/ and the brick's *-api template, bar a commented NOT_REVIEWED list. A test fixture per class is in tooling/ci/test/autopilot-review-gate.test.mjs.
